content.short: Chainalysis delivers blockchain intelligence for investigations, compliance, fraud prevention, and risk monitoring across crypto.
content.description: Chainalysis is a blockchain intelligence company used by exchanges, financial institutions, investigators, and regulators to understand on-chain activity and manage crypto risk. Its official platform is positioned around investigations, compliance, fraud prevention, and data driven monitoring, with products such as Reactor, Rapid, Wallet Scan, and broader data services. Rather than acting as a TON-native protocol, Chainalysis supports organizations that need to trace funds, review exposure, monitor suspicious behavior, and build evidence or compliance workflows across multiple blockchain ecosystems.
content.meta: Explore Chainalysis, a blockchain intelligence platform for investigations, compliance, fraud prevention, and crypto risk monitoring.
